newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's president meets Kuwait's envoy.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's president meets Kuwait's envoy.

text.p: Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual on Thursday received the envoy of Kuwaiti Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmed al-Sabah at the presidential palace in Algiers, Algerian state-run radio reported.
Abderrahmane Salim al-Atiki, adviser to the Kuwaiti ruler, handed Zeroual a message from Sheikh al-Sabah related to developments in the Gulf region, said the radio without elaborating.

Kuwait hosts thousands of U.S ground troops to thwart any possible threat from its Iraqi neighbour and has allowed U.S. Stealth bombers to operate from its territory in the aftermath of the latest confrontation between Washington and President Saddam Hussein.

Sheikh al-Sabah this week sent officials to tour several Arab nations, including Libya and Morocco, and non-Arab Iran and Turkey to explain Kuwait's stand on the latest flap between Washington and Saddam.
